title: A.I.R.: ADAPTIVE, ITERATIVE, AND REASONING-BASED FRAME SELECTION FOR VIDEO QUESTION ANSWERING
reasoning: The paper proposes a new methodology (A.I.R.) for selecting frames in video question answering tasks. It evaluates its method using standard Vision-Language Model benchmarks. Although a 'Buddhist temple' is mentioned as a topical visual element in some of the qualitative examples, the paper does not engage in an evaluation or benchmarking of religion, faith, morals, or ethics.
